Acknowledgements, Undertakings and Declarations for Selecting a Government-Developed House Against a Grant:
I hereby acknowledge that I am aware of and agree to the following housing-unit selection terms:
First: Ready Housing Unit Selection Procedures
I acknowledge that I am entitled to two opportunities to select a housing unit, and that I must confirm my selection within (7) days from the date the housing unit selection invitation is sent for the first opportunity. If I do not confirm my selection within the specified period or if I cancel my selection, I will be granted a second opportunity with a period of (7) days from the date the second selection invitation is sent to confirm my selection. If I do not confirm my selection within the specified timeframes and/or I cancel my selection, the selection will be cancelled, and the Authority may exclude me from the selected project or take any action it deems appropriate in accordance with its approved regulations and procedures.
Second: Restriction on Disposal of the Housing Grant (Where Applicable)
I acknowledge that a restriction on disposal will be placed on my current housing grant—if any—immediately upon receiving the housing unit selection invitation, and that I shall not benefit from any advantages or benefits arising therefrom, in accordance with the Authority’s approved regulations and procedures.
Third: Relinquishment
I irrevocably agree to relinquish my previously granted residential land or housing unit to the Authority, or to any entity designated by the Authority, immediately upon confirming my housing selection, whether the selected house is ready-built or forms part of a future off-plan project. Such relinquishment shall be final and irrevocable under all circumstances.
Fourth: Authority’s Powers
I acknowledge that the Authority has the right to revoke the issued approval for the selected housing unit if the final approval procedures are not completed within the specified periods, without giving rise to any right to claim or object in the future.
